lines.zh: 篷车辙印，我闭眼都认得。
lines.en: I know wagon ruts with my eyes shut.
The sand burns my feet, so I trot.

lines.zh: 我跟在最后一辆篷车后面。
lines.en: I trail behind the last wagon.
The acacia shade lies over there.
I trot, and the dust follows me.
A wagon axle creaks up ahead.
Dry grass crunches under my feet.

lines.zh: 我踩着自己的影子赶路。
lines.en: I walk on my own shadow to keep up.
We've been on this road for days.
Stones sting my feet, so I go around.
Hot wind blows my fur into knots.
Only when the wagons stop do I stretch.
The sun's too fierce; I hide under the cart.
I sprawl on the wooden boards and doze.
My ears twitch, shooing the flies.
Sand has worked its way into my fur.
I bury my nose between my front paws.

lines.zh: 远处有狮子叫，我装没听见。
lines.en: A lion calls far off; I pretend not to hear.
The smell of wagon canvas makes me sleepy.
I scratch my ear with a hind leg.
The cart's shadow slowly turns toward me.
I lick the dry grass crumbs off my lips.

lines.zh: 热得我连尾巴都懒得动。
lines.en: Too hot to even flick my tail.
There's a small hollow in the sand, mine.
I count the driver's yawns.
Leaning on the wheel feels good.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在前腿上，看沙。
lines.en: I rest my chin on my forelegs and watch the sand.

lines.zh: 一只甲虫爬过我的爪子，我不管。
lines.en: A beetle crosses my paw. I let it.

lines.zh: 车夫在打瞌睡，我也跟着。
lines.en: The carter dozes. I follow along.

lines.zh: 我伸个懒腰，肚皮贴住热沙。
lines.en: I stretch out and press my belly to warm sand.
Are you the new wagon driver?

lines.zh: 我歪头，看你手上的布包。
lines.en: I tilt my head at the cloth bundle in your hand.
Your boots carry no sand.
I look up and wait for you to kneel.

lines.zh: 你身上有别的路的气味。
lines.en: You smell of some other road.
Would you pat my head?

lines.zh: 我从车底探出半个身子。
lines.en: I lean halfway out from under the cart.
Don't stand in the sun; you'll faint.

lines.zh: 你笑的时候，我就不怕了。
lines.en: When you smile, I stop being afraid.
I blink; sand got in my eye.
Were you brought here by wagon too?
I keep staring at your waterskin.
I yelp once and dive under the cart.
Sand grinds into the wound.

lines.zh: 这一下比车轴夹的还疼。
lines.en: It hurts worse than the axle pinch.
I tuck my tail and shrink back.
Don't kick me; I was following along.
My legs are weak; I can barely stand.
The caravan people will hear this.

lines.zh: 沙沾在伤口上，舔起来发苦。
lines.en: Sand sticks in the cut; licking tastes bitter.
I crawl toward the wagon wheel.
It hurts so much my cry goes quiet.
Isn't that saved for the driver?
I only eat dry grass and salt.

lines.zh: 你手里那点，不够一队分。
lines.en: What you hold won't feed the whole train.
I smell it, but I won't snatch.
The people on the wagon eat first.
That's too sweet; it draws insects.
I step back, then can't help looking.
Just a few crumbs will do.
Feed me and I'll follow you.
Caravan rules: I don't eat first.

lines.zh: 我从篷车轮子边溜过去。
lines.en: I slip past the caravan wheel.
Sorry, I stepped on your foot.
A wagon wheel pressed me to the side.
I press against the boards and freeze.
I rolled once across the sand.
You're in my path; please move.
Dust off my back, then keep walking.

lines.zh: 撞一下没什么，我不记仇。
lines.en: A bump is nothing; I hold no grudge.
I retreat behind the wagon wheel.
That cart is harder than I am.
We share the same nest of grass.

lines.zh: 我给她留了最软的干草。
lines.en: I saved her the softest dry grass.
Two small shadows on the sand.
She grooms the fur on my neck.
We call to each other, very softly.
When the wheels rattle, she leans closer.
With her here, the road feels half as long.

lines.zh: 我守着她睡过整个热天。
lines.en: I watch over her through the whole hot day.
Our nest lies under the wagon.
Tomorrow's road, we walk together.
This is a nail the caravan dropped.
The copper scrap glints; I carry it off.
I pick it up and tuck it in the nest.
Could this be traded for water?
The driver would like this one.
With this in my teeth, I can't run.
There's another one under the sand.
I dig the shiny thing out.
Leave it; it belongs to the caravan.

lines.zh: 我藏了一颗当过冬的粮。
lines.en: I hid one away for the lean season.

lines.zh: 沙下的动静我全听得见。
lines.en: I hear everything moving under the sand.
I squeeze to the deepest part under the cart.
That isn't a hyena; it's a fox.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，车夫没听见。
lines.en: I call out; the driver doesn't hear.
I crouch low with my ears pinned back.
That shadow's too thin; it's starving.
I hide behind the wooden wheel.
I tuck my tail in tight.
If it comes close, I'll cry out.
Don't let it see you.
I keep watching that sand ridge.
I creep half a step and stop.
It circles around the caravan.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里发出很小的声音。
lines.en: A tiny sound rises in my throat.
I'll drink once it's gone.
I count how many circles it makes.
The wind carries its smell to me.

lines.zh: 我踩住你的靴尖，提醒你。
lines.en: I step on your boot tip to warn you.
The people in the wagon are singing.
I don't dare blink.
I clamp down on its toe.
I'm small; one bite is all I get.
After the bite, I dive under the cart.
My teeth go shallow, but they hurt.
My hind legs kick up a spray of sand.

lines.zh: 别小看篷车上的小东西。
lines.en: Don't underestimate the small ones on wagons.
I clawed it right on the nose.
My cry is louder than my bite.
It backs off; I'm still trembling.
Did the driver see that?
The wagon stops and I'm set down.
Another stretch of new sand.
The sun is right overhead.
First I find a spot under the cart.
Strange sand, familiar wagon ruts.
I shake off the dust of the road.
Which caravan holds this ground?
I smell water somewhere close.
Someone has pulled back the canvas.
I stand in the middle of the ruts.
The hot wind has changed direction.
New place; first I walk a circle.
Fire nears the canvas; I cry and cry.

lines.zh: 从车板上摔下，我滚了两圈。
lines.en: I fall off the boards and roll twice.
The puddle is deeper than I thought.
The blast tips the whole wagon over.
The arrow lands in the sand, very near me.

lines.zh: 紫光让我忘了回车的路。
lines.en: The violet light makes me forget the way back.
The hay ran out; I chew sand.

lines.zh: 雷打中金合欢，我吓僵了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the acacia; I freeze in fear.
Nothing underfoot but emptiness, not sand.
